FIELD EXPECTATIONS

Competitive doesn’t have to mean complicated.

The exact rules depend on the field, operator and insurer. The baseline is simple: control the field, protect players and keep the stop signal absolute.

Controlled field and referee stop authority
Required eye and face protection
Gear inactive outside active play
Spectators and waiting players outside the active field

Closed-toe shoes recommended
FAQ

The useful questions.

What is a gel blaster?

A gel blaster is recreational game equipment that launches hydrated gel beads. DGL uses it inside a controlled, referee-led field experience rather than free-roaming play.

Do I need my own gear?

No. The first DGL event is being designed with event gear provided. Final equipment details will be included with the confirmed session information.

Where is the first event?

Arizona. The final field is being confirmed now. First Drop members hear the confirmed location and date first.

Can families play?

Yes, DGL is planning family-focused sessions. Final minimum ages and guardian requirements will follow the operator, insurer and venue rules.

What should I wear?

Comfortable athletic clothing and closed-toe shoes are the baseline recommendation. Final field-specific guidance will come with the event details.
